## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the first the light blue bowl with darkened rim and stack the others on top.

Task description: The targets are three light-blue bowls with dark rims; the bowl at the front right of the table is the first one. Stack the other two on top of it.

Success criteria: Nest three bowls compactly, with adjacent layers nearly coincident laterally and longitudinally. Keep the bottom layer near the table and the upper two fully lowered to form a low stack. Both grippers must be open.

## Execution tips

- Choose a continuous, visible rim section with ample clearance. Place one finger inside and one outside, gripping along the local wall normal. Match the opening to wall thickness and fingertip entry clearance rather than spanning the whole bowl opening.
- Before closing, confirm the fingers are on the inner and outer sides of the bowl wall, with the pads contacting the wall below the rim. Avoid catching only the thin edge with the fingertips, which could slip during transport.
- Keep the bowl opening facing up during transport. As you move it above the stack, keep its bottom high enough to clear the rims of the existing bowls, avoiding a collision that could shift the lower bowl.
- Lower gradually while nesting the bowls. If one side hits the rim first or the bowl tilts noticeably, lift slightly and adjust the horizontal position instead of pressing further and catching the rim or tipping the stack.
- If the outside finger prevents further nesting, gradually release after the lower bowl reliably supports the held bowl, then withdraw above the rim. Avoid trapping fingers between bowl walls or lifting the stack during withdrawal.
